name: DOSRender
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering with Occlusion and Instance Tracking
definition: A volume rendering technique that accumulates color and occlusion along a ray while tracking instance and group IDs for semantic segmentation, using a slice-based approach with extinction coefficients.
summary: DOSRender is a depth-ordered, slice-based volume rendering technique that integrates precomputed occlusion samples and hierarchical group membership buffers directly into the accumulation pass for efficient occlusion-aware rendering and semantic data extraction.
